scope: Opt-in, bounded partial inspection of one producer-specific AC1018 TABLECONTENT profile. Ordinary object dispatch, typed callbacks and output gates are unchanged.

authority.oda_pdf: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, SHA256 1ed2e02722862188120da606e4b6a816fa4014c96de68da2f84a2ecda09461e7, sections 2.2–2.5, 2.12, 2.13, 20.1 and 20.4.97–101. The specification dates standalone TABLECONTENT to 2008; this is a producer-specific out-of-version AC1018 occurrence.
authority.source_walk: p5-ac1018-tablecontent-complete-body-walk-2026-11-11.json independently walks source bit fields and compares them with the same vendor's DXF projection. That projection is not an independent native semantic oracle.

implementation: The opt-in observer verifies custom class/self identity and a no-EED/no-reactor/no-extension common shell, then reuses bounded TABLECONTENT helpers with AC1018 inline body/text and a separately positioned handle cursor. It does not alter the ordinary parser's AC1018 refusal.

The candidate retains the complete raw body plus each ASCII TV's bit interval and exact bytes, including trailing NUL. Its typed TABLECONTENT projection is partial: custom maps, styles and other fields remain represented only by source bytes/ranges and do not imply semantic or write completeness.

Require a 3x3 layout before allocating row/column/cell containers, exactly 45 TV spans, 17 null H5 text-style slots, 33 null H5 border-linetype slots and one nonnull H5 TABLESTYLE, a nonnull H4 parent, exact data/handle end and fewer than eight zero padding bits. Reject unobserved handle kinds, named CMC colors, unobserved CadValue types, non-ASCII/embedded-NUL TVs, reserved BL/BD forms and contradictory validated common-link metadata.

A 64 KiB input cap, per-count cap of six, 45-TV and 51-handle limits and a 12,000-unit observer work budget bound candidate work. Candidate-only thread-local trace and alternate-probe state are restored by RAII; rejected input and allocation exceptions clear the result. No public callback or input carrier authenticates source provenance.

validation.focused_command: cmake --build build --target libdxfrw_dwg_tablecontent_ac1018_candidate_tests libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip -j 3; ctest --test-dir build -R '^libdxfrw_(table_content_dwg_object_roundtrip|table_content_style_id_domains|table_content_dwg_payload_encoder|table_content_cell_style_border_alignment|table_content_override_style_types|dwg_tablecontent_ac1018_candidate)$' --output-on-failure
validation.result: 6/6 passed. The locally authored 3x3 body independently records and compares every TV and handle offset, payload, kind, role and reference, including seven trailing-NUL TVs. Boundary truncations, wrong identity/common metadata, malformed roles/padding, reserved BL/BD and CMC BL, named colors, non-ASCII/embedded NUL, excessive counts, repeated long TVs/custom data, and oversized declared binary/point variants are refused with cleared result.
validation.fault_scope: The generated success measured 2,779 allocations; eight selected allocation offsets were injected and each permitted a corrected retry. This is sampled coverage, not an exhaustive fault sweep. Generated and physical observations used 1,620 and 1,799 work units respectively; the candidate ceiling is 12,000.
validation.physical_callback: One actual reader callback reported candidate success, parent 0xbc, data end 13313, handle end 13745, 45 TV and 51 field-tagged handle spans. The separately executed comparator matched every TV start/end/raw byte sequence and handle field/start/end/role/size/reference to the pinned source walk; seven TVs retain a final NUL.
reproduction: Run tools/research/p5_ac1018_tablecontent_interior_verify.py using the pinned source, peer JSON, same-vendor DXF and body directory described in p5-ac1018-tablecontent-complete-body-walk-2026-11-11.json; save its JSON to /private/tmp/p5-tablecontent-interior-reference.json.

Compile tools/research/p5_ac1018_tablecontent_candidate_probe.cpp with -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror, include src and dwg2dxf, and link build/tests/CMakeFiles/libdxfrw_test_adapter.dir/__/dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp.o and build/libdxfrw.a; run it on the pinned DWG and save stdout as /private/tmp/p5-tablecontent-candidate.json.

Run python3 tools/research/p5_ac1018_tablecontent_candidate_compare.py --source /private/tmp/p5-desc-input/input.dwg --candidate /private/tmp/p5-tablecontent-candidate.json --reference /private/tmp/p5-tablecontent-interior-reference.json. PASS reports 45 text and 51 handle spans.
validation.provenance_limit: The comparator verifies the source digest and source-walk result but cannot authenticate arbitrary supplied candidate JSON; it must be produced by the stated callback probe. No external DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

remaining: CRC-authenticated reader-origin binding for TABLECONTENT, exact non-null dependency roles and TABLESTYLE closure, codepage 45 in XRECORDs, DATATABLE and nine descendant graph closure, HEADER integrity, foreign/native semantics and transactional writer/readback remain open. The candidate carries no output authorization.
